name: Gondwana Rainforests of Australia
description: Spread across 41 reserves in north-east New South Wales and south-east Queensland, these rainforests cover roughly 370,000 hectares along Australia's Great Escarpment. They shelter ferns, conifers and flowering plants descended from lineages that date back to the ancient supercontinent Gondwana, including some found nowhere else. Ancient volcanic landscapes and stands of Antarctic beech add to the appeal for visitors.
